name: jaeger-adjustdecoy
instr:
**Postgres spans of orders end up outside the request in the trace view**

We set `max_clock_skew_adjust: 30s` on jaeger_query a while back because the orders boxes drift by a couple of seconds. orders is still on Brave and reports over Zipkin; most other services use the OTel SDK over OTLP.

Since then every checkout trace looks off the same way. The orders server span sits nicely inside the frontend's call, but the postgres queries under it are drawn about two seconds later, after the orders span has finished. The MCP `get_critical_path` tool leaves those queries out and books the whole orders span as its own time, which is how we noticed. Traces that only touch our OTel services look fine as far as I can tell.

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, as a _test.go file in the package it exercises (say ./repro_test.go), that fails on the current code because
of this problem (a real test failure, not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added.

I doubt I'm the only one hitting this. Anything else that goes through that code is probably
wrong too, so please fix it at the source rather than special-casing my input. The fix belongs in
